boundary.zh: Pontx Hub 在 /openapi.json 发布的无鉴权、只读发现和 Skill 分发接口；不包括账户、AI、Playground 执行、OAuth 辅助或内部路由。
boundary.en: The unauthenticated, read-only discovery and Skill-distribution routes that Pontx Hub publishes at /openapi.json; account, AI, Playground execution, OAuth-helper, and internal routes are excluded.

authDecision.zh: 所有已收录 Endpoint 均可匿名读取。受账户身份或服务端预算保护的路由尚未形成第三方授权服务器/资源服务器契约，因此保持私有，不能通过现有网站 Cookie 或 GitHub 登录令牌调用。
authDecision.en: Every admitted Endpoint is anonymously readable. Routes protected by an account identity or a server-side budget do not yet have a third-party authorization-server/resource-server contract, so they remain private and cannot be called with an existing website cookie or GitHub sign-in token.
